post.summary: Validate a brief, caption or image
post.description: Briefs and captions are checked against the active policy and the study facts before this returns, so state is already SUCCEEDED; job_id equals validation_run_id until validation runs as a job. Images need DEMO_STUBS (501 otherwise); poll those until SUCCEEDED. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key and body returns the original run. Each brief or caption run also stores the policy context it was checked against (see GET /validations/{validation_run_id}/context). What that context can't settle is part of the stored run: a mandatory rule with a missing source, unresolved applicability or an incomplete walk is UNABLE_TO_ASSESS, one in a conflict NEEDS_REVIEW, and a FAIL stays FAIL; the run is then never PASS. If the context can't be gathered at all (each of its database queries has a time limit), every mandatory rule is UNABLE_TO_ASSESS. Gaps on optional rules are coverage gaps only.

simulated.title: Simulated
simulated.description: True only in local and demo environments: no real malware scan ran.

url.description: Short-lived and secret: do not store, log or share it.

manifest_sha256.title: Manifest Sha256
manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of the stored context's canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) when the run used it. Null for runs stored before it was recorded.

post_format.description: Null when the run's manifest predates recording it.

ValidationContextRead.title: ValidationContextRead
ValidationContextRead.description:
The policy context stored for one validation run: which rules it had to use and why.

Evidence only for now: the run's outcome comes from the rule checks until NRC-7's judge uses
this context. A code in missing_context means the context is incomplete, never a pass.
